summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style entry on Allison DuBois, born January 24, 1972, an American author and purported medium. It states that she has used her claimed psychic abilities to help U.S. law enforcement solve crimes, and that these cases formed the basis of the TV series Medium. The text is duplicated, with the second version attributing the claims to DuBois's own statements.
one_line: Allison DuBois is an American author and purported medium whose claimed police-assisting psychic work inspired the TV series Medium.
key_facts: Allison DuBois was born on January 24, 1972.
Allison DuBois is described as an American author and purported medium.
DuBois has used her psychic abilities to assist U.S. law enforcement officials in solving crimes.
The crime-solving work of Allison DuBois formed the basis of the TV series Medium.
A second version of the note states that DuBois has stated her psychic abilities have assisted U.S. law enforcement officials in solving crimes.
The note describes Allison DuBois as a purported medium, not as a confirmed psychic.
The note's second version attributes the law enforcement claims to DuBois's own statements.
The note appears twice in nearly identical form, with the same birth date and TV series reference in both.
